card.name: Inside the word flaccidity
card.fires_on: The piece "acc" in "flaccidity" (skeletal muscle flaccidity) in opioid overdose symptom lists.

modes.label: Flaccidity in overdose signs
modes.description: The "acc" piece after "fl" in the list of opioid overdose signs that follows respiratory depression and somnolence.
modes.example: Acute overdose with morphine can be manifested by respiratory depression, somnolence progressing to stupor or coma, skeletal muscle fl<<acc>>idity, cold and clammy skin,
